status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/grants-program/proposed_items.json. Sources are named, never read here; 'source unknown' carries the question that would find one. A brief reference names who asked, not the system of record.

gaps.name: Grant (funding program and project: NGen 14091, FedDev, AMIC, ISED AI-CAF) with its agreement, periods and status
gaps.ontology_today: No grant or funding-program type; nothing in Portal, Sage relations or the BC grammar names a grant.
gaps.open_question: Where are the NGen project 14091 agreement, budget and claim periods kept (SharePoint site and library, funder portal), and who owns them?

gaps.name: Eligible cost row (the shared Purchase / Cost Line, from the claim workbook)
gaps.ontology_today: Purchase objects exist (Sage PO, BC purchase invoices, Portal PO) but no Cost Line; the asset case records the same missing edge (evals/dev/asset-tracker/ontology_gaps.json AT-GAP-10).
gaps.open_question: Where is the NGen Q10 claim workbook (site, library, file name) and which revision was submitted to the funder?

gaps.name: Eligibility ruling (per invoice line: ruling, decider, date, cited source)
gaps.ontology_today: No ruling or decision object for funder eligibility; mail is readable but no mailbox is known to hold rulings.
gaps.open_question: Where do NGen eligibility rulings such as the Q9 review arrive (funder portal message, letter, mail to which mailbox), and who at PLX keeps them?

gaps.name: Funder claim (claim period, claimed and reimbursed amounts per cost)
gaps.ontology_today: No claim object; no reader for any funder portal.
gaps.open_question: Which funder portal and cadence does NGen use for claims, can its submitted claims and reimbursements be exported read-only, and who is the contact?

gaps.name: Hours (person, period, project, hours) charged to a grant project
gaps.ontology_today: No time-entry type. Portal holds employee rates, not hours, and they are not served; the BC grammar excludes employees and payroll; the reporting API excludes wages and person names.

sources.relation: decision D3 (excludes wages and person names)

gaps.open_question: Which system records hours worked on NGen 14091 by person and period (payroll project coding, a timesheet workbook), and can hours be read without wages?

gaps.name: Cost row to invoice and payment proof
gaps.ontology_today: Invoice and payment objects are readable in BC and Sage PO relations are served, but no key from a cost row to them is known.
gaps.open_question: Which key does a Q10 cost row carry to its invoice and payment (vendor invoice number, BC document number, Sage PO, cheque or EFT reference)?

gaps.name: Cost row to funder claims (one cost, many claims)
gaps.ontology_today: No claim object, so no edge; the asset case records the same funder-claim edge as missing (AT-GAP-10).
gaps.open_question: When one cost is claimed to more than one funder, where is that split recorded and which cost key does each claim line carry?

gaps.name: Cost or hours to deliverable and partner delivery
gaps.open_question: Where are NGen 14091 deliverables and partner deliveries tracked, and which key ties a cost or an hours entry to one?

gaps.name: Purchase or invoice line to grant project coding
gaps.ontology_today: BC dimensions are readable, but whether any dimension codes a grant project is unverified; Sage AP/G-L relations are not served.
gaps.open_question: Does PLX code NGen 14091 costs and payroll to the project in BC (a dimension), in Sage (a job or G/L segment) or only in the claim workbook?

gaps.name: Claim workbooks and invoice PDFs as originals
gaps.ontology_today: The brief is the only registered grants original; the Q10 workbook, the over-$500 PDFs and the Q9 review are not captured, so nothing can be recounted or cited.
gaps.open_question: Which SharePoint site and library hold the NGen claim workbooks and supporting invoice PDFs, and may the Workbench capture them read-only?

gaps.name: Sage AP and G/L (invoice and payment coding)
gaps.ontology_today: The reporting API serves Sage PO, order and invoice-to-customer relations but no AP or G/L relation.

sources.relation: allowlist (no Sage AP or G/L entries)

gaps.open_question: Which Sage AP or G/L tables hold the vendor invoices and payments claimed to NGen, and can the reporting API serve them read-only?

gaps.name: Funder portal (submitted claims, rulings, reimbursements)
gaps.ontology_today: No reader; the brief forbids writes to funder portals, so any reader would be read-only exports.
gaps.open_question: Does the NGen funder portal offer a read-only export or API for submitted claims, rulings and reimbursements, and who holds access?
